//: This project intentionally does NOT extend the app's tsconfig.json. Edge functions run on Deno, not Node/React Native — they have their own module resolution (URL imports) and global scope (Deno.env, etc.). The app's tsconfig.json excludes this folder entirely; this file exists only so editors opening these files directly don't flag Deno-specific syntax as errors. It is not wired into the app's build.
